payload.entry: Planning evidence before source edits: no prior-work notes or remaining-work handoff; choose tale/medium. Inspected 1311536, d8a828f and fetched c7a5f37 (cc.9); read CI logs 40225855522 and 40358201800. Per-test classification: (1) Design renderTabsLoaded expects old previous-tab morning_notes; current contract selects today_report. Hover fixture likewise must target a different open row while retaining XCTAssertNotEqual. (2) Tabs restore test query keep + papers filters out kept chat/small_reading before select, so its nil selection/90 offset failures are invalid fixture setup, not evidence to relax restore behavior. (3-4) Focus publish and reselection tests expose a product bug: inspectorLoader.$content emits in willSet, but tryFireHighlightsKeyFocus rereads inspectorLoader.content and sees old data; use the emitted map and test one-shot delivery. (5) TabSwitch test opens an ephemeral Highlights session then expects the next library show to stay in Tabs, contrary to 1311536 documented restore contract; split ordinary-Tabs consumption coverage from ephemeral restoration. (6) CurrentTab failure at 1311536 line 3125 is specifically currentID=nil while selected/preselected assertions passed; libraryDidPublish reconstructs RefsTabsListing without currentID, so preserve the field and force a refresh regression. c7a5f37 retains both product defects. cc coordination note records the Copy restore fixture issue and leaves Copy-specific changes to cc. epic-symbols currently reports no entries. No implementation or XCTest execution yet.

Planning evidence: reproduced the ledger pollution in the existing task-status-cycler host harness on clean bob-plugins c036597c5f05d92a1ee79f821c392c01cfbb5bf0. reopenActivePomodoroTask calls setActiveCheckboxStatus, which calls stampFreshnessOnEditorLine; the real ledger-tools stamper adapted with .line adds fresh to timed, placeholder, and legacy section headlines. Real linked tasks also stamp, so their behavior must be retained. Rust stamp_inner and JS stamp/keep/setRefresh share the missing ledger exclusion. Read-only live Stats still reports 205 worked minutes for 2026-10-25, VIBE 65 plus polluted VIBE 15, and the polluted theme_hues key. No application or live-vault files changed. Authored a medium tale with caller/context guards, canonical Rust/JS guards, regressions, deployment, and the mandatory human-approved repair gate; validation passed with zero warnings. Submitting through sase plan propose for the implementation continuation.

payload.entry:
BASELINE: every vault/metadata/overlay/scan event called publishRelationIndex(), which copied the records Map, rebuilt relationIndexTaskMemo() over every Tasks task, and walked all edges.

FIX: event-driven publishes now schedule one microtask rebuild via scheduleRelationIndexPublish(); api.relationIndex v1 reads (generation, ready, outgoing, incoming, labelSuggestions) and relationLabels.rows flush a pending publish so v1 never serves a stale snapshot; the Tasks task memo is reused until that turn ends.

TESTS: npm test 3777 pass; npm run validate pass. New coverage in scripts/test-ledger-tools-relation-index.cjs: 40 metadata events produce one publish, one memo build, and one onChange; a v1 read after an event flushes the pending rebuild without waiting for the microtask.

COST: synthetic 40-file index — uncoalesced apply+flush 27.6ms, coalesced event-stack 0.58ms + turn 1.43ms. Vault copy (6725 md, 3223 prefiltered, 250 synthetic relations) — uncoalesced storm 196.96ms vs coalesced 140.79ms (40 parses of a 293KB daily plus one publish).

DEPLOY: rebased onto origin/master 5790364, rebuilt, bob plugins sync --no-pull -p bob-ledger-tools from this checkout; copied main.js.

LIMITATIONS: bob-cli-a5 left open for the lander. Distinct async turns (scan chunks, target-read promises) still publish separately. Live Obsidian renderer cost was not measured in-app.

DECISIONS: theme_field_strip and legacy_key do not apply to this phase.

Coalesced event-driven relation-index publishes to one microtask rebuild with same-turn task-memo reuse; v1 reads flush pending state. Verified: npm test 3777 pass, npm run validate pass, storm test (40 events → 1 publish + 1 memo), read-after-event freshness, vault storm 196.96ms → 140.79ms, deployed bob-ledger-tools via bob plugins sync after rebase onto origin/master 5790364. Left bob-cli-a5 open for the lander. No --epic-symbol leftovers.

payload.entry:
Implementation, tests, deployment, and live-repair gate status for fresh-stamp-ledger-guard.

Root cause: reopenActivePomodoroTask -> setActiveCheckboxStatus -> stampFreshnessOnEditorLine, with canonical JS/Rust placement helpers accepting any open checkbox. Timed, placeholder, and legacy Pomodoro headlines were eligible; linked task sources were correctly stamped.

Writer inventory (common guards):
- Canonical placement: Rust stamp_inner via is_pomodoro_ledger_line (stamp_fresh, set_refresh, stamp_fresh_preserve_keeps). JS freshnessStampLine / freshnessKeepLine / freshnessSetRefreshLine via freshnessIsPomodoroLedgerLine. Refusals use not_task and are byte-exact, including already-polluted rows. markUnblockedLine unchanged.
- Delegation: cycler 010-core.js applyFreshStampLine; nav 470-keydown-and-freshness.js applyFreshStampLine / applyFreshRefreshLine (line-only plus optional ## Pomodoros section context); block-id-prompt 030-tasks-and-dependencies.js applyFreshStampLine. Injected/older stampers cannot stamp a recognizable ledger body.
- Context-aware: cycler 180/190 isPomodoroLedgerLineInEditor / InSourceText using findPomodorosSectionInLines + isPomodoroTaskLine (covers local, Tasks-command follow-up, fallback rewrite, and legacy headings). Nav callers pass {content, line} into the shared writer (blocks stage, counted batches, lane/link commit, freshness refresh, decay keep/classifyRottenKeepTarget, project subtree, schedule, task-move, etc.).
- Nested real tasks, quoted/indented rows with a time only in prose, and Task Link sources remain eligible.

Revisions:
- bob-cli 6f2f19324083835fdd36f34c25dd4f3fef8d5a6d plus uncommitted docs/freshness.md, src/native/freshness/placement.rs, placement_tests.rs (P19/P20 + rustfmt).
- bob-plugins rebased onto origin/master 241ca2d818eb8381d0c672c877f0415b0b1546f6; uncommitted writer-guard fragment/main.js/test edits.

Tests (this-phase):
- rustfmt on placement_tests.rs was the just-check failure; cargo fmt applied. cargo test --lib native::freshness::placement::placement_tests: 48 passed.
- Focused JS after rebase: 123 passed (reopen, cycler freshness, placement including keep, keeps file, navigation stamps, block-id).
- Repair fixture tests in /tmp/test_repair_pomodoro_fresh_stamp.py: unique repair, second-invocation no-op, drift abort, duplicate abort, CRLF preserved, preview/decline do not write.

Verification gates:
- just check (monitor nyah4w72b3hn): failed cargo fmt --check on placement_tests.rs only; later stages not reached. rustfmt now clean.
- just docs-check / bob-plugins docs:check: BOB_TEST_FIXTURE_PDF undocumented in source_store.rs (bob-cli-cc). See PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP.
- bob-plugins build: pass. validate: pass on the earlier monitor; npm test after rebase has 19 origin/master failures unrelated to this phase (see PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP). Command-mode CLICOLOR_FORCE failure from the monitor did not reproduce after rebase (test-command-mode-runner.cjs 13/13).

Deployment:
- Rebased bob-plugins onto current origin/master (4 commits: command-mode sheet, relation-index coalesce, day-strip bars, managed-only dependencies).
- bob plugins sync --no-pull -r linked checkout -p for block-id-prompt, bob-ledger-tools, bob-navigation-hotkeys, task-status-cycler. Backups: /home/bryan/.local/state/bob-cli/plugin-backups/20261026-140819
- bob plugins list after: 7 synced, 1 drift. Remaining drift is bob-command-mode (disabled in vault); not deployed because this phase did not change it and a full sync would clobber a larger vault copy.

Live evidence before repair (bob stats show worked -a -f json -g day -r 2026-10-25..2026-10-25):
- vault-sync SHA 92c3a71ee3fef1396d100efc49d3c7b039476e1d, in sync.
- 2026/20261025.md session 1020-1035 at reported line 38, name "VIBE [fresh:: 2026-10-25]", 15m, total worked 205.
- theme parts VIBE 65 + "VIBE [FRESH:: 2026-10-25]" 15; theme_hues keys vibe and "vibe [fresh:: 2026-10-25]".
- Expected after unique-line repair: VIBE 80, total 205, session name VIBE.

Repair gate: authored auto=false because the parent plan forbids live-vault mutation without a Bryan-approved /sase_gate turn. Plan approval is not that authorization. Compare-before-write locates the unique headline in 2026/20261025.md (not line 38), holds bob_sync.lock, preserves newline style, no-ops an already-repaired unique CLEAN line, and aborts on missing/ambiguous preimages. Preview is an operation. Repair writes only; successor must inspect vault status and run bob vault-sync if the only dirty path is that daily note. epic-symbols: no --epic-symbol entries. Phase left open for the gate successor to record the human outcome and close.

Parent plan assigns this source-store doctor/docs baseline to bob-cli-cc. Monitor nyah4w72b3hn. This phase did not change source_store.rs. Catalog/completion/help tests were not reached in just check because cargo fmt --check failed first on placement_tests.rs (now formatted).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: origin/master bob-plugins test red on 241ca2d — after rebase, npm test reports 19 failures that reproduce on a clean origin/master tree with this phase's edits stashed: 18x scripts/test-dependency-line-migration.cjs `migration requires nav helper parseDependencyLegacyChildDetails`, plus scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage-performance.cjs `stage collections reuse one snapshot per parent` (expected null, actual undefined). Introduced by origin `241ca2d feat(navigation): read dependencies from managed lines only`. Focused freshness regressions stay green. Do not treat as this phase's writer-guard regression.

VERIFICATION CLOSEOUT (2026-10-26)

Modified paths in bob-mac-capture:
- Sources/BobMacCapture/Refs/RefsPanelModel.swift
- Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelModelTests.swift
- Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelDesignTests.swift

Planned test classification and correction:
1. RefsPanelDesignTests.testRefsPanelStatesToPNG had outdated fixture assertions: the loaded state now selects focused today_report, and the hover image uses unselected morning_notes. Current identity, caption, row-count, and unselected checks remain.
2. testHighlightsTabsShowResetsAndLibraryRestoresTheFilter had an invalid query/scope that excluded small_reading before selection. The fixture now uses small + chats and retains exact view, selection, inspector offset 90, and list offset 200 restore checks.
3. testHighlightsKeyFocusPublishesAndReveals and testHighlightsKeyFocusReselectionRearmsAndCtrlDCancels exposed a product bug: the @Published willSet callback reread stale loader content. Focus now evaluates the emitted content snapshot; regression coverage checks event delivery, both content/snapshot arrival orders, rearming, and cancellation.
4. testTabSwitchUsesTheSwitcherPreselectionOnceOnTheNextShow expected ordinary tabs behavior from an ephemeral Highlights session. Coverage now exercises persistent Tabs with one-time preselection and a separate ephemeral-session restore case.
5. testHighlightsKeySelectsCurrentTab exposed a product bug: libraryDidPublish rebuilt RefsTabsListing without currentID. Refresh now preserves a still-listed current ID and clears one outside the refreshed listing; regression coverage exercises both.

Verification:
- just portable-check in bob-mac-capture passed, exit 0, both before and during the final scratch run.
- Initial mac scratch typecheck failed on two test closure argument errors in RefsPanelModelTests.swift (lines 3377 and 3513); those errors were corrected. Final isolated scratch run on SSH alias mac completed ./Scripts/bundle.sh --identity - and just typecheck-tests successfully, exit 0. BobMacCapture, install-helper, CaptureCore, and RefsCore targets reported PASS, and MAC_SCRATCH_CLEANED confirmed deletion. The Mac has Command Line Tools without XCTest, so typecheck-tests used the stub and did not execute XCTest behavior; real XCTest results remain for CI.
- just check in the primary bob-cli workspace failed with exit 101 before tests. The primary checkout was clean at HEAD 36ae0ef0ae4fe4fd49b6916eb04431a2738f4eab. Both baseline StoreWriteParams initializers lack verified: src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs:3566 and src/native/highlights_ref/overwrite/execute.rs:3329. The same state is in the clean base; this is unrelated to RefsPanel. Existing tracking is recorded on bob-cli-cc.10, and plan 202610/fix_store_write_params_verified.md records the later repair as commit e9a955f9225f304a421a2cf755b39c985f9b6800. No new bead is needed.
- sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.6.2 returned no --epic-symbol entries.

The phase work and available checks are complete. Keep bob-cli-ci, bob-cli-cc, and all ancestors with their landers.
